#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

long long solve(int n, int mod) {
    if (n <= 3) {
        return 0;
    }
    long long last_value = 17;
    long long total_value = 17;
    int max_length = (n - 1) * (n - 2) / 2 + 1;
    int toggle_bit = 1;
    vector<vector<long long>> table(2, vector<long long>(max_length + 1, 0));
    table[0][0] = 1;
    table[0][1] = 2;
    table[0][2] = 2;
    table[0][3] = 1;
    for (int m = 4; m < n; ++m) {
        int total_pairs = m * (m - 1) / 2;
        total_value = (long long)(m + 1) * last_value;
        long long partial_sum = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
            partial_sum += table[toggle_bit ^ 1][i];
            table[toggle_bit][i] = partial_sum % mod;
        }
        for (int i = m; i <= total_pairs / 2; ++i) {
            partial_sum += table[toggle_bit ^ 1][i];
            partial_sum -= table[toggle_bit ^ 1][i - m];
            table[toggle_bit][i] = partial_sum % mod;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= total_pairs / 2; ++i) {
            table[toggle_bit][total_pairs - i] = table[toggle_bit][i];
        }
        long long total_acc = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < total_pairs; ++i) {
            long long temp_sum = 0;
            int start_idx = max(1, -total_pairs + i + m + 2);
            for (int j = start_idx; j <= m; ++j) {
                int index = m + 2 - j + i;
                if (index >= 0 && index <= total_pairs) {
                    temp_sum += j * (long long)table[toggle_bit][index];
                }
            }
            total_acc += (long long)table[toggle_bit][i];
            total_acc %= mod;
            temp_sum %= mod;
            total_value += (temp_sum * total_acc) % mod;
            total_value %= mod;
        }
        last_value = total_value;
        toggle_bit ^= 1;
    }
    return total_value % mod;
}

int main() {
    int n, mod;
    cin >> n >> mod;
    cout << solve(n, mod) << "\n";
    return 0;
}
